description: Originals clear themselves 30 days after every network has the post, keeping the poster, details and links to the post, so storage counts only what's still needed. keep true holds this one's original for good (it keeps counting toward storage); keep false lets it clear again. A cleared original can't come back: upload the file again.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

keep.description: true: never clear the original; false: clear it after posting like the rest

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: media_keep
title: Keep media after posting
